title: A1 Swaara v1.0.9 - Player Controls, Playlist & Downloads Update
changelog:
- Fixed Auto-Downloading: Streamed playback caching is now completely decoupled from offline downloads; songs only appear in Downloads when explicitly downloaded
- Add to Playlist from Player: Seamlessly add the currently playing song to any playlist or create a new playlist on the fly from the top bar or Track Options
- Futuristic Animated Loop Button: Dynamic 360-degree rotation animation with distinct active visual states and high-contrast Repeat-One badge
- Refined Player Alignment: Mathematically aligned 5-column primary and secondary control rows across portrait and landscape screens
